U-M’s rich athletics tradition began in 1865 and continues to this day with the Wolverines claiming more than 50 national championships in 12 sports. Our students, faculty and staff also regularly participate in dozens of intramural, club sport and fitness activities. U-M Athletics is proud to provide life changing opportunities to more than 900 student-athletes across 29 sports. Students play a late night game of tennis at Palmer Field courts outside of the Mosher-Jordan Residence Hall.
